name: Waterkloof Trail, Naukluft
why: Up a kloof of rock pools that hold water all year to the plateau at 1,900 m, then a long loop back down to camp.
book: Book and pay at Naukluft reception. It starts at the camp; not guided.
water: Rock pools in the first hour; none after. Carry 2-3 litres.
dangers: Long and exposed to the sun after the pools: start early.
Baboons raid the camp: lock food in the car.
turnaround: Not at the high point by 12:00: go back down the kloof the way you came.

points.name: Naukluft campsite
points.note: The trail leaves from the campsite and heads west up the kloof.

points.name: Waterkloof rock pools
points.note: Clear pools in the kloof, about 30 minutes from camp; they hold water through the dry season.

points.name: Waterkloof high point
points.note: The top of the loop, about 1,900 m, on the plateau west of camp. From here the path turns back east and down to camp.
